summary: Iteration 3 — Live KPI data feed for landing-page Impact section. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass on the new /api/stats endpoints (public shape + auto-seed singleton, volunteers count reflects new volunteer creation, people_held increments when a Layer-1 card with consent is created and DECREASES by 1 after revoke, GET /stats/admin requires auth and accepts both admin+volunteer, PATCH /stats/admin admin-only with role=403 for volunteer, negative values blocked by Pydantic 422, post-PATCH values immediately reflected on /stats/public with updated_by set to admin email). Frontend: Impact section renders 4 tiles in correct order (Fridays served, Meals shared, Volunteers, People held) with count-up animation, skeleton pulse on load resolves to live values, 'live · last refreshed <date>' label visible (data-testid=stats-updated-at). CRM admin sees data-testid=crm-kpi-btn 'Edit landing KPIs', volunteer correctly does NOT see it. KPI editor opens, prefills current values from /stats/admin, save triggers PATCH + success toast 'KPIs published to the landing page', and landing page Impact section reflects the new numbers (verified: 182+ fridays / 3.5k+ meals after saving 182/3450).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/stats/public correctly seeds singleton on first call (idempotent — repeat reads do not duplicate) and excludes _id via projection.
PATCH /api/stats/admin uses upsert with $setOnInsert id='singleton' — defensive against races where the singleton was deleted out-of-band. Good.
Pydantic StatsOverrideIn has ge=0/le=100000 and le=10000000 bounds — both ends covered, prevents accidental fat-finger overflow.

Role gate is double-enforced: require_operator dependency keeps non-operators out, then explicit `if user.role != 'admin'` raises 403 inside PATCH. The mirroring is fine but consider extracting a `require_admin` dependency for symmetry with require_operator.

people_held query `{layer: {$gte: 1}, 'consent.revoked_at': null}` is correct against the current revoke semantics (revoke sets layer=0 AND revoked_at=ISO string). Either condition would suffice today, but keeping both is defensive against future changes that may move only one.
Impact.jsx useCountUp hook is clean and cancellable; formatValue's `k+` rendering matches the prior static design — good visual continuity.
KPIEditor.jsx uses authedAxios from AuthContext so token refresh / 401 handling is consistent with the rest of the CRM — no new auth-leakage surface.
Minor: Impact.jsx swallows the actual error in axios catch (`catch {}`). Consider logging err to console for production debugging — currently a transient outage looks identical to a 500.

Minor: stats_overrides singleton stores `updated_at` as ISO string but seed path also writes ISO string — consistent, but could move to native BSON datetime to match a future analytics need (matches the same pattern flagged on person_cards last iteration).
Minor: server.py 552 lines — still under the 700-line guideline but trending up; consider splitting auth + cards + stats routers into separate modules when adding the next feature.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 stats tests, after fixing test email TLD)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical flows (landing live feed, RBAC button gating, KPI edit → save → propagation to landing)
